========================================
_Atomic functional form in a typedef and a declaration
========================================

typedef _Atomic(int) t;
_Atomic(int) a;

---

(translation_unit
  (type_definition
    type: (macro_type_specifier name: (identifier) type: (type_descriptor type: (primitive_type)))
    declarator: (type_identifier))
  (declaration
    type: (macro_type_specifier name: (identifier) type: (type_descriptor type: (primitive_type)))
    declarator: (identifier)))

========================================
_Atomic functional form in a struct field and a parameter
========================================

struct S { _Atomic(unsigned) u; };
void f(_Atomic(int) *p);

---

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    name: (type_identifier)
    body: (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        type: (macro_type_specifier
          name: (identifier)
          type: (type_descriptor type: (sized_type_specifier)))
        declarator: (field_identifier))))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (macro_type_specifier
            name: (identifier)
            type: (type_descriptor type: (primitive_type)))
          declarator: (pointer_declarator declarator: (identifier)))))))

========================================
_Atomic qualifier form still parses
========================================

_Atomic int b;
static _Atomic int c;

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration (type_qualifier) type: (primitive_type) declarator: (identifier))
  (declaration (storage_class_specifier) (type_qualifier) type: (primitive_type) declarator: (identifier)))
